mapper.insert: INSERT INTO serial_transfer_command(id,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,context_hash,payload,next_check_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{e},#{w},#{hash},CAST(#{payload} AS JSON),#{now},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM serial_transfer_command WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM serial_transfer_command WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND state='PENDING' AND next_check_at <=#{now} ORDER BY next_check_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE serial_transfer_command SET state=IF(#{complete},'COMPLETE','PENDING'),next_check_at=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='PENDING'
